deployments_detail.use: "Naries" time-series AI predicts shipment/production volumes for inventory optimization (Apr 2025)
"Ligla" AI chat on LINE for recipe/menu recommendations

"Naries" demand-supply adjustment system: a time-series AI model forecasts future shipment volumes from historical shipment data and automatically drafts replenishment/production plans, monitoring plan-vs-actual variance to flag stockout/overstock risk. Replaces person-dependent manual demand-supply planning. [Mt.SQUARE (time-series AI model)]

Joint R&D AI model predicting optimal ingredient-and-soy-sauce flavor pairings ("deliciousness" / compatibility prediction) to guide entry into emerging markets such as India, combining Kikkoman's fermentation/brewing knowledge with machine learning. [Athena Technologies]
"LiveTalk" AI speech/translation system deployed at KIKKOMAN LIVE KITCHEN TOKYO (Yurakucho/Ginza) to explain chefs' live cooking demonstrations to guests in 20+ languages in real time. [LiveTalk]

Generative-AI-assisted employee engagement / management transformation: AI structures qualitative survey feedback, extracts discussion points and generates hypotheses on organizational issues so managers focus on decision-making and dialogue. Rolled out across the management layer with standardized prompts/templates. [ABeam Consulting (generative AI)]

Dataiku analytics/ML platform adopted by the International Business Division's Digital Promotion Group to move from data visualization to predictive modeling and to build an AI-enabled analytics organization across overseas operations. [Dataiku (via Keywalker)]

Forecast Pro statistical/ML demand-forecasting system that auto-selects optimal forecasting algorithms across ~2,000 SKUs, integrated into the host system; automates routine forecasts (~150 of 500 Noda items) so planners focus on hard-to-predict items. [Forecast Pro (Hitachi Solutions East)]

"Mitsukaru Kyou no Gohan" conversational AI recipe agent on Kikkoman's official LINE account. Users chat about fridge ingredients, cooking time and family preferences; the AI recommends dishes from a 9,000+ recipe database via the mascot "Naanai-chan". [Ligla / TimeTechnologies Inc.]
